//: Lighthouse CI runs against the built static output (dist/client) so dev-server quirks never affect scores. The url list is EXPLICIT on purpose: with staticDistDir alone, lhci auto-discovers pages but caps at 5, testing a near-random subset. Listing URLs covers every distinct template and skips non-page stubs. Accessibility is a HARD gate (must hold 100); performance / best-practices / SEO are warnings so normal CI variance doesn't block a PR. The site is output: 'static', so there are no SSR routes to exclude. The three CMS-driven templates (/events/[slug], /sermons/[slug], custom /[slug] pages) are represented by one slug each; the production dataset is public so the token-less CI build emits them too. If a listed slug is unpublished, swap in another of the same template. Run locally: npm run build && npx lhci autorun
